711070202.text: Excuse me... What is this place?

711070204.text: If you're lost... keep following that road over there, it'll take you to Yilong Wharf.

711070205.text: Hmm, Wangshan Hall? Now where has Paimon heard this name before...?

711070206.text: Oh yeah! Paimon remembers now! ... That's the stronghold of the Guhua Clan, right!?

711070208.text: Wow, Paimon never expected it would be in this sort of place... Well, can we go in and look around?

711070209.text: Look around, you say? I didn't think outsiders would want to visit such a remote, mountainous place!

711070210.text: But since you're here, let me fetch one of my seniors to show you around. I'm not urbane or eloquent enough to receive visitors, I fear.

711070211.text: You two wait here while I go to Yilong Wharf. I won't be long!

711070212.text: Even before the voice of Wen the Fourth has faded, he has turned and disappeared into the forest...

711070213.text: Whoa! Impressive! Now you see him, now you don't!

711070214.text: So that's real qinggong in action, eh...

711070215.text: Wait, hang on a second. Did he just say Yilong Wharf!? So how long are we gonna be waiting!?

711070216.text: Well, seeing as he's proficient in martial arts, it probably won't take him too long to get from here to there...

711070217.text: Nothing for it but to wait, then.

711070218.text: It is not long before Wen the Fourth returns with another person...

711070219.text: Hey, c'mon, a bit slower, will you? These old bones can't keep up with your pace...

711070220.text: ...I AM going slow. And let's be real, you're the one who's neglected your skills for so long that you've put on all this meat...

711070221.text: Enough, that's enough. Don't say such things in front of visitors!

711070222.text: Er, and this old gentleman is...?

711070223.text: Huang the Third of the Guhua Clan. Some people know me as the Cloudpiercing Arrow.

711070224.text: Cloudpiercing Arrow...? So you're a talented archer?

711070225.text: Haha, it was just a moniker bestowed on me in my youth. Pay it no mind.

711070226.text: Hmph, what do you mean "bestowed upon"? You just call yourself that...

711070227.text: Why don't you just keep a lid on it? Ahem... Anyway, you'd like to visit Wangshan Hall, right?

711070229.text: Haha, very good! With your skills, perhaps you might find the treasures left by Grand Master Guhua!

711070232.text: Quite so! Grand Master Guhua secretly established 12 Secret Chambers within the Hall upon the Clan's founding, in which he placed treasures now lost to the world.

711070233.text: 12 Secret Chambers, eh? That's very specific of you. Did you take the time to count them yourself...?

711070236.text: Wangshan Hall is hewn from the mountain stone itself, and its structure is complex and intricate. Over millennia, only a handful of these hidden chambers have been discovered. The locations of many others are unknown even to us disciples.

711070238.text: I see... Alas! Would it not be a shame if the treasures housed still within Wangshan Hall will remain thus neglected, deep within the mountains...! A shame. Such a shame!

711070241.text: Quite so! Grand Master Guhua secretly established 12 Secret Chambers within the Hall upon the Clan's founding, in which he placed treasures now lost to the world.

711070242.text: Wangshan Hall is hewn from the mountain stone itself, and its structure is complex and intricate. Over millennia, only a handful of these hidden chambers have been discovered. The locations of many others are unknown even to us disciples.

711070243.text: Oh... Even we disciples don't know where they are, and you're bringing outsiders in?

711070244.text: Brother, you... Calm yourself. Stop interrupting me!

711070245.text: I sense something special about you. Perchance you might stumble across one of Grand Master Guhua's hidden chambers during your visit to this historical site!

711070103.text: #I behold {M#your immaculate appearance, with eyes as bright as shining stars}{F#your extraordinary beauty, a divinity in this mortal world}, and know from this one glance that you nobly wander this land. Therefore, prithee tarry a while, as I make so bold to request your good name?

711070105.text: Haha, your breathtaking confidence is a rarity. I have certainly not erred!

711070106.text: #What in the world are you banging on about... You too, {NICKNAME}! Don't let a few compliments go to your head!

711070107.text: #Ahem, anyway, Paimon at your service. {M#He's}{F#She's} {NICKNAME}. And you are...?

711070111.text: Ah, yes. Where are my manners? Huang the Third of the Guhua Clan, at your service. Some people know me as the Cloudpiercing Arrow.

711070112.text: Cloudpiercing Arrow...? So you're a talented archer?

711070113.text: Haha, it was just a moniker bestowed on me in my youth. Pay it no mind.

711070114.text: Oh, so you're Huang the Third! The one they call the Cloudpiercing Arrow...

711070115.text: Hey, don't tell Paimon you've heard of this guy!?

711070116.text: Wait a minute, did you just say... Guhua Clan?

711070117.text: Oh? Are you familiar with our clan's name?

711070109.text: #Precisely! I perceived your uncommon demeanor with one glance. You must also be an itinerant {M#hero}{F#heroine}, are you not?

711070110.text: #Er, dunno about any itinerant whatevers. But anyway, Paimon, at your service. {M#He's}{F# She's} {NICKNAME}. And you are...?

711070301.text: (No... How can you take those antiques out without maintaining them!? What if...)

711070302.text: (Hey, you don't get it... If I did that, and people saw that the paint was new, would they still be willing to come play... I mean, come train!? The sense of history is... whatchamacallit... Hey!)

711070303.text: (...And anyway, the two of us don't have that much spare cash...)

711070304.text: Oh, oh... Welcome! I see you've made it to our stronghold — Wangshan Hall!

711070307.text: Haha, worry not! This is my junior brother, known in our circles as Wen the Fourth, and by the people as the Snowstriding Sword.

711070309.text: However, Wangshan Hall is, in the end, very important to us. Custom dictates, therefore, that outsiders who wish to enter must first pass two trials.

711070310.text: Put another way, we first wish to see just how skilled you are!

711070312.text: (Well, just look what gullible fish just got on the hook...)

711070313.text: Of course, of course! These two tests will certainly be a walk in the park for your illustrious selves!

711070314.text: It's just that these are the rules of our clan, and we can't simply change them arbitrarily. Please forgive me.

711070318.text: Boo... Nothing for it. We do want the treasure from those 12 Secret Chambers...

711070319.text: The 12 Secret Chambers, eh? Haven't you told these guests a lot? Did you count those chambers specifically...?

711070322.text: So, what exactly do I need to do?

711070323.text: It's very simple. Please, follow me!

711070316.text: Haha, no need to worry! These two tests will certainly be a walk in the park for your illustrious selves!

711070317.text: It's just that these are the rules of our clan, and we can't simply change them arbitrarily. Please forgive me.

subQuests.subQuestName: Follow Huang the Third to the site of the trial

711071005.text: Behold the Plumwatcher Piles, passed down by Grand Master Guhua!

711071006.text: It was upon these stones that Grand Master Guhua practiced back in the day, diligently cultivating the technique to become a true master! Over there, the ancient trees were also planted by our founder's hand...

711071007.text: Wow, they're all at crazy angles, and some are even broken in half...

711071008.text: It's probably due to years of disrepair and neglect...

711071009.text: Ahem... Of course not! It's merely to increase the difficulty of the training, nothing more! After all, there won't be neat stone piles to step on in a real battle, will there?

711071010.text: Nobody would step on one of these things in a real fight either!

711071011.text: #...In any case! For the first trial, I ask that you step on the stone piles in the order I specify within the allotted time, {NICKNAME}. Show me what you've got!

subQuests.subQuestName: Learn about the rules for the trial

711071101.text: Behold the Plumwatcher Piles, passed down by Grand Master Guhua himself!

711071102.text: It was upon these stones that Grand Master Guhua practiced back in the day, diligently cultivating the technique to become a true master! Over there, the ancient trees were also planted by our founder's hand...

711071103.text: Wow, they're all at crazy angles, and some are even broken in half...

711071104.text: It's probably due to years of disrepair and neglect...

711071105.text: Ahem... Of course not! It's merely to increase the difficulty of the training, nothing more! After all, there won't be neat stone piles to step on in a real battle, will there?

711071106.text: Nobody would step on one of these things in a real fight either!

711071107.text: #...In any case! For the first trial, I ask that you step on the stone piles in the order I specify within the allotted time, {NICKNAME}. Show me what you've got!

711071110.text: #C'mon, {NICKNAME}, you've got this! If you wanna get the treasure... Ahem, Paimon means, if you wanna pass the trial, you've gotta be willing to put in the effort!

711074101.text: Such extraordinary technique! You moved like a swallow in flight, with not a droplet of water staining your wings. Such unparalleled grace is truly worthy of a hero!

711074104.text: Hmm... Does using a wind glider count as a technique?

711074105.text: Haha, it looks like you still have much to learn about traditional martial arts, child.

711074106.text: I ask you this: When a wandering hero strides out and brings bandits and thieves alike to justice, was it their skill that deserves credit, or their sword's?

711074107.text: Uh... The hero's skill, of course!

711074108.text: Correct! Even the sharpest blade is ineffective in the hands of one who knows not how to wield it.

711074109.text: #It is by this same reasoning that {NICKNAME} could use {M#his}{F#her} wind glider so superbly. This is the kind of mastery we strive for in Guhua martial arts!

711074110.text: Hmm, that does make sense. But it also doesn't make sense at all...

711074111.text: #With that, let me congratulate you on acing the first trial, {NICKNAME}! For the second trial, we must proceed to the practice arena. Please come with me!

711074113.text: That's right, and Paimon will be cheering you on!

subQuests.subQuestName: Follow Huang the Third to the site of the next trial
Learn about the rules for the trial

711070502.text: Back then, the reputation of the Guhua Clan was known throughout Liyue. But what was it based on? It was based on the spear and sword skills developed right here!

711070503.text: The dual mastery of polearm and sword we are known for is the result of arduous practice, day after day!

711070506.text: This is the second trial, the Trial of Spear and Sword! Just one moment while I get the training equipment out...

711070507.text: Huang the Third produces a bunch of dusty bamboo dummies from somewhere...

711070508.text: Phew, I'm exhausted... Okay! Anyway, would you please display your skills on these dummies?

711070512.text: Take a look. Some of these dummies are <color=#80CCFFFF>dressed in blue</color> while others are <color=#FF8080FF>dressed in red</color>.

711070513.text: The battlefield may turn on a dime. You must be able to distinguish friend from foe. To clear this trial, defeat all the dummies <color=#FF8080FF>dressed in red</color> within the allotted time!

711070514.text: #If you strike a dummy <color=#80CCFFFF>dressed in blue</color>, you lose. Stay alert, {NICKNAME}!

711070515.text: Ooh, Paimon gets it! So, you have to attack the dummies <color=#FF8080FF>in red</color> without hitting a single dummy <color=#80CCFFFF>in blue</color>...

711070511.text: Haha, surely you jest! Who could train in such a ludicrous fashion?

711073001.text: I'm not sure what delicacy you've prepared, but I'll just wait over here!

711075101.text: Woohoo! That means we've successfully cleared the stage, right?

711075104.text: A—Amazing! You effortlessly defeated all the targets with outstanding speed and accuracy! Even among our disciples, few can ever hope to rival you!

711075105.text: Are you the master of another clan, here on some secret visit?

711071806.text: Back then, the reputation of the Guhua Clan was known throughout Liyue. But what was it based on? It was based on the spear and sword skills developed right here!

711071807.text: The dual mastery of polearm and sword we are known for is the result of arduous practice, day after day!

subQuests.subQuestName: Tour Wangshan Hall with Huang the Third

711071901.text: Behold, the lifeblood of our clan for a millennium — Wangshan Hall!

711071904.text: When Grand Master Guhua founded our clan, this was a place of untold majesty where great heroes from all over gathered in merriment and endless song...

711071905.text: Even the realm of the adepti pales in comparison to Wangshan Hall!

711071906.text: Hmm... Speaking of which, what does the name mean anyway?

711071907.text: Haha, I'll tell you! Legend has it that when Grand Master Guhua wandered the world, his sword terrified all bandits, and the countryside boasted of being as peaceful as the city...

711071908.text: The mountain thieves were as frightened of Guhua as they were of tigers. The tiger is king over the beasts, and thus did the locals under the grand master's protection call this place Wangshan Hall out of respect for his supremacy over the mountains.

subQuests.subQuestName: Tour Wangshan Hall with Huang the Third
Speak with Huang the Third and go to the next location

711072001.text: #What do you think? If you've seen enough of this place, shall I bring you to the next spot, {NICKNAME}?

subQuests.subQuestName: Tour Wangshan Hall with Huang the Third
Speak with Huang the Third and go to the next location

711072301.text: #What do you think? If you've seen enough of this place, shall I bring you to the next spot, {NICKNAME}?

subQuests.subQuestName: Tour Wangshan Hall with Huang the Third

711072102.text: Haha, this is the Arcane Archive, where all the ancient mysteries and secrets of the Guhua Clan are hidden, so only our own disciples are allowed within.

711072103.text: Is that so... This is as far as we go, then!

711072104.text: Alright! That concludes the tour of Wangshan Hall!

711072105.text: Huh? It's over already? What about the treasures?

711072106.text: Haha, treasure isn't something you just randomly find! You know, in all these centuries, many a disciple has sought out the grand master's treasures, but none have succeeded...

711072107.text: Oh... In that case, let's take another look around nearby!

711072108.text: Not so fast! If you wish to continue exploring our clan's secrets, you must follow its rules with a show of good faith.

711072109.text: Take Grand Master Guhua for example — in his time, disciples who wished to master spear and sword also had to pay tuition...

711072113.text: Paimon's never heard of the Guhua Clan cheating people of their Mora either!

711072114.text: That's... We're not cheating people of anything! Ahem... We don't need Mora, exactly, but rules are rules! In Grand Master Guhua's time, it wasn't Mora he accepted, but rice and salted meat...

711072115.text: Huh? So, you want food, not money?

711072116.text: Well... *sigh* Fine, if you don't have Mora, you can just make me something to eat! That's what our predecessors did. As a great hero, surely that's within your means?

711072117.text: #After all, we value a helping hand in times of need. It's all up to you, as long as it's from the heart. I have no intention of extorting you, {NICKNAME} — I just wouldn't want you to have a guilty conscience!

subQuests.subQuestName: Step to the side and listen to Paimon's idea

711073301.text: Hmph! Didn't he say "The Guhua Clan used to accept rice and salted meat"? Then why don't we fulfill his wish, and make him some salted meat?

711073302.text: Seemingly fired up by the thought, the usually-lazy Paimon begins to set up a campfire all by herself...

711073303.text: It's supposed to be a salted dish, so it doesn't really matter how much salt we actually cover this thing with, right?

711073305.text: Ugh, Paimon feels a little bad, ruining perfectly good food... No, no, it's too late to feel bad about it now! And either way, it's all that guy's fault!

711073306.text: #Now it's time to add the salt! Hehe, Paimon will leave that to you, {NICKNAME}!

711073308.text: Wh—What do you mean? Hey, if anyone's going a bit too far, wouldn't it be that guy? He tricked us into coming here with the promise of treasure, and even wanted us to cook for him for free!

711073309.text: #Someone like that has to be taught a lesson! If he doesn't learn that what he's doing is wrong, he will just continue to scam other people once we leave this place! Isn't that right, {NICKNAME}?

711073312.text: There's no need to be stingy! You can add more, like this—

711073314.text: Yep, now that's more like it! Keep going!

subQuests.subQuestName: Give Paimon's special dish to Huang the Third

711073402.text: #Oh! You sure work quickly, {NICKNAME}! In just the blink of an eye, you've already prepared such a sumptuous dish!

711072201.text: Huang the Third takes a bite out of Paimon's special salted meat dish...\n

711072202.text: Huang the Third takes a bite out of Paimon's special salted meat dish...\nBefore his muscles have finished masticating the first mouthful, he has already pushed the plate of meat aside, and made a mad dash to the nearby pond, where he ingurgitates several large gulps of water...

711072205.text: That's... That's right! No wonder they call you the Cloudpiercing Arrow, Huang the Third! We could barely keep up...

711072206.text: Wait, that's not the point! This is our specially-made salted meat dish, our "helping hand in times of need"! This came from our hearts, just as you asked!

711072208.text: Hehe, this is our "helping hand in times of need"! This came from our hearts, just as you asked!

711074205.text: Such extraordinary technique! You moved with remarkable finesse, like a swallow in flight. Such unparalleled grace is truly worthy of a hero!

711074207.text: #Huh? What are you talking about? {NICKNAME} fell right into the water! Good thing {M#he}{F#she} can swim...

711074208.text: Haha, it looks like you still have much to learn about traditional martial arts, child.

711074210.text: You see... This trial is meant to test visitors against these stone piles.

711074211.text: But how could a few stone piles gauge the limits of your extraordinary technique? Doubtless, you intentionally went off the beaten path and dropped into the water to display your true skill...

711074212.text: You fell exactly above the array's core, and as you swam back ashore, you perfectly undid said array. Others may not understand these profundities, but how could it ever escape me, the Cloudpiercing Arrow?

711074204.text: Come on, be careful! *sigh* It's a good thing there's only water under these poles... Had it been solid ground, you probably would have gotten hurt.

711074303.text: Such extraordinary technique! You moved like a swallow in flight, with not a droplet of water staining your wings. Such unparalleled grace is truly worthy of a hero!

711074305.text: Wait! How the heck did you come to that conclusion!? It wasn't completed at all!

711074306.text: Haha, it looks like you still have much to learn about traditional martial arts, child.

711074308.text: You see... This trial is meant to test visitors against these stone piles.

711074309.text: #Let me ask you a question. Did your companion lose {M#his}{F#her} footing and fall into the water?

711074311.text: #And that is where the secret lies! If the goal was only to follow the rules and move about on the wooden piles, then it would have been a piece of cake with {NICKNAME}'s agility.

711074312.text: But the great do not allow themselves to be bound by rules!

711074313.text: #Just clearing the first few wooden piles was enough to prove {NICKNAME}'s skill, and standing firm afterward demonstrated uncompromising will! An admirable combination of integrity and skill, indeed!

711074315.text: Eh... Are you two being serious?

711074317.text: #With that, let me congratulate you on acing the first trial, {NICKNAME}! For the second trial, we must proceed to the practice arena. Please come with me!

711074319.text: No, but you didn't win either!

711074401.text: Hey! Why are you just standing there?

711074403.text: Oh, come on, how could you get distracted at a time like this?

711074404.text: Excellent! Only a true hero like you could have immediately seen through the true essence of this trial!

711074407.text: #If the goal was only to follow the rules and move about on the stone piles, then I'm sure {NICKNAME}'s agility would have made short work of it.

711074408.text: #But {NICKNAME} stood still on the spot. Now, why is that?

711074418.text: Haha, it looks like you still have much to learn about traditional martial arts, child.

711074419.text: You see... This trial is meant to test visitors against these stone piles.

711074420.text: #As our predecessors once said, the prudent should foresee danger and take precautions. This is exactly what they meant! And {NICKNAME} would rather give up on the trial than betray this principle. Truly admirable!

711074411.text: You say that, but Paimon doesn't think you've ever been scared of heights before...

711074412.text: Excellent! Only a true hero like you could have immediately seen through the true essence of this trial!

711074415.text: #If the goal was only to follow the rules and move about on the stone piles, then I'm sure {NICKNAME}'s agility would have made short work of it.

711074416.text: #But {NICKNAME} stood still on the spot. Now, why is that?

711074505.text: Excellent! Who knew you could hold your breath underwater for so long and still seem so alive after being fished out... No, you're completely fine! A true hero indeed!

711074507.text: #What do you mean, holding {M#his}{F#her} breath underwater!? {M#He}{F#She} clearly swallowed a ton of water down there!

711074508.text: Haha, it looks like you still have much to learn about traditional martial arts, child.

711074509.text: I ask you this: When a wandering hero strides out and brings bandits and thieves alike to justice, was it their skill that deserves credit, or their sword's?

711074510.text: Uh... The hero's skill, of course... Wait! What has that go to do with anything?

711074511.text: Everything! Everyone knows that holding your breath in the open air is part of the basics while holding your breath underwater is the supreme technique!

711074512.text: #As they say, the form of martial arts is fluid, and anything can be a sword. Even flowers and leaves can harm others. {NICKNAME}'s mastery, therefore, is truly admirable!

711074504.text: Hey, that's not something to be proud of! You could've gotten hurt there! Seriously, take better care of yourself!

711075201.text: Whoa, we accidentally hit one of those dummies in blue!

711075202.text: There goes the stage, and the treasure with it...

711075205.text: A—Amazing! You saw through such a meticulous disguise with a single glance!

711075207.text: #The dummies in blue {NICKNAME} just hit were the spies hiding among us!

711075209.text: Haha! Don't you understand, little one? As they say, you never know what lurks on the inside. How could they be distinguished by appearance alone?

711075210.text: #Yet, {NICKNAME} saw through their appearance and peered into their very nature! Such perception truly is the pinnacle of skill!

711075301.text: Whoa, we accidentally hit one of those dummies in blue!

711075302.text: We also didn't manage to hit all the ones in red... There goes the stage, and also the treasure...

711075305.text: A—Amazing! You saw through such a meticulous disguise with a single glance!

711075307.text: #The dummies in blue {NICKNAME} just hit were the impostors hiding among us! And the dummies in red that were spared? They were our undercover agents!

711075308.text: Hmm... and how could you tell?

711075309.text: Haha! Don't you understand, little one? As they say, you never know what lurks on the inside. How could they be distinguished by appearance alone?

711075310.text: #Yet, {NICKNAME} saw through their appearance and peered into their very nature! Such perception truly is the pinnacle of skill!

711075402.text: There goes the stage, and the treasure with it...

711075405.text: A—Amazing! You saw through such a meticulous disguise with a single glance!

711075407.text: #The dummies in red that {NICKNAME} just spared were our undercover agents! Hitting them by accident would be no different from hitting ourselves on the head!

711075408.text: U—Undercover agents? How could you tell?

711075409.text: Haha! Don't you understand, little one? As they say, you never know what lurks on the inside. How could they be distinguished by appearance alone?

711075410.text: #Yet, {NICKNAME} saw through their appearance and peered into their very nature! Such perception truly is the pinnacle of skill!

711075501.text: #{NICKNAME}! Why are you just standing there?

711075502.text: There goes the stage, and the treasure with it...

711075504.text: Wow, Paimon didn't know you could zone out even at a time like this...

711075509.text: Excellent! I've never met someone so understanding and righteous in all my life! I truly admire you!

711075510.text: #Wait! There's nothing to admire about that! {NICKNAME} just stood there on the spot!

711075511.text: Haha! You fail to see beyond the surface of things!

711075513.text: #{NICKNAME}'s skill is more than enough to instantly take down all those dummies in red. But that is not the Way.

711075514.text: Some swords in this world take life, and some give it. Taking life is easy, and giving it, hard. And the greatest principle in martial arts is to not kill!

711075515.text: #While they may be dummies made of bamboo, they still symbolize living beings. {NICKNAME}'s compassion and decision to feign distraction just to protect the innocent, even at the cost of failing the trial... It's truly admirable!

711075508.text: Uh... Well, you do have a point... How are we supposed to know which ones to hit between all the dummies of different colors...

711076103.text: Outsiders who seek to enter Wangshan Hall must pass two trials. This rule has existed since ancient times.

711076104.text: However... Forget it, if my senior thinks it's all right, then I have nothing to say about it. Anyway, there's nothing to worry about. <color=#00E1FFFF>Anyone can pass</color> the trials as they are right now.

711076106.text: ...You will understand soon enough. Go on, don't let me keep you. My senior is waiting.

711076108.text: Go on, my senior is waiting.

711076205.text: But you need more practice if you seek to further yourself.

711076206.text: I saw the way you moved just now. I won't comment on the details, but it was pretty good overall. I'm certain it will become a great weapon in your arsenal if you work hard on it.

711076207.text: Hah... I may say that, but even now, it far surpasses anything my senior is capable of.

711076304.text: Forget it... If my senior thinks it's all right, then I have nothing to say about it. So don't ask me.

711076305.text: I never expected our clan to end up in such a state... Yet there is nothing that can be done...

711076401.text: If you have anything to ask about the Guhua Clan... Feel free to ask me. As for what my senior said... Don't believe everything he says.

711076403.text: Wangshan Hall is the main house of the Guhua Clan and where Grand Master Guhua attained enlightenment.

711076404.text: Now, it is in ruins and unusable... Besides my senior and I, no one else remains to guard this place.

711076405.text: Even our current Master merely visits occasionally.

711076407.text: The Guhua Clan was once known as the Guhua Brotherhood. We looked up to the chivalry of Grand Master Guhua and traveled the world with our swords and spears... Our mastery of both was known to all.

711076408.text: Sigh... But as time passed, the clan's glory was no more...

711076418.text: Grand Master Guhua was our founder, but not the clan's first master.

711076419.text: The grand master was a wandering hero who brought peace and justice to the people while traveling the world. He never intended to start a clan. This place wasn't always known as Wangshan Hall, instead being known as the "Lingmeng Chamber."

711076420.text: After the grand master passed away, Boxuan... better known as Master Baixuan, who once received his favor, established the Guhua Brotherhood in his name and called himself a disciple of Guhua to carry on the grand master's legacy.

711076421.text: So they were a self-proclaimed disciple?

711076422.text: Indeed. The grand master never took one.

711076423.text: Unfortunately, the glory of the clan faded with time. We, disciples of future generations, failed the clan. Now, we no longer seek to restore the clan's glory, merely to uphold justice and live up to the grand master's name.

711076424.text: And that's why the disciples of the Guhua Clan are spread all over Liyue?

711076425.text: Exactly. After all, there are places in the world where the sun doesn't shine, and we cannot leave everything to Rex Lapis.

711076426.text: But... My only consolation is a promising junior — Xingqiu. If he can restore our former glory... Then we of the older generation can die without regrets.

711076428.text: ...Forgive me for not accompanying you. Farewell.

711076501.text: Sigh... To think that after a thousand years of heritage, the Guhua Clan's head doorkeeper must cheat others to survive... What shall we do, what can be done...

711076502.text: Ugh... Alright, come on now. Am I not sparing my junior from starving to death while guarding our gates...?

711076503.text: #And don't look at me like that. You're always depressed... But you were pleased to see {NICKNAME}'s performance just now, weren't you?

711076504.text: That fool from before? They get to take a look around in exchange for making you a meal? And I should be pleased about that? Were I a few years younger, I would slay you in one smack...

711076505.text: Heh! Your technique was inferior to mine just a few years ago!

711076506.text: ...Anyway, listen... Only a few of us geezers are left. What do you plan to do after we stop testing those who may be destined to join us? Take those books with us to our graves?

711076508.text: Hah... Just forget it. What's the point of saying such depressing things?

711076509.text: Oh, why don't you try the food those kids made me? Hehe! I think it's better than Wanmin Restaurant's fare! Here, take a bite! Just a bite!

711079901.text: (No... How can you take those antiques out without maintaining them!? What if...)

711079902.text: (Hey, you don't get it... If I did that, and people saw that the paint was new, would they still be willing to come play... I mean, come train!? The sense of history is... whatchamacallit... Hey!)

711079903.text: (...And anyway, the two of us don't have that much spare cash...)

711079904.text: Simply incredible! This way next, please.

711079905.text: #Not bad! Your skill is truly extraordinary, {M#Young Hero}{F#Young Heroine}!

711079906.text: Okay! Almost there, one last step!

711079908.text: #Not bad, that's exactly it! You truly are wise and farsighted beyond ordinary folk, {M#Young Hero}{F#Young Heroine}, and you have superb skill, too!

711079909.text: Behold! This is the arsenal of Wangshan Hall! Spears, swords, halberds... Anything you can think of, you'll find it here!

711079915.text: Huh? There seems to be a censer here.

711079916.text: Haha, good eye! The memorial tablet of our ancestral founder, Guhua, is enshrined here!

711079917.text: Our grand master traveled the world, and the only reason the clan has lasted a thousand years is because the world admires his virtue and remembers him with gratitude.

711079918.text: Um, Huang the Third... The way you're walking...

711079919.text: Haha! How embarrassing! Anyway, this is the Guhua Clan's secret movement technique — Soaring Swallow! Forgive me for not showing it to you earlier, but it's a rule of our clan...

711079920.text: Um, Paimon just wanted to ask... You're shaking like a leaf all of a sudden. Are you not feeling well? Or do you just need a break...

711079923.text: This tablet is here to remind future generations of our clan to never forget the teachings of our ancestors... To help those in need and bring peace to the people.

711079924.text: Ah. As ever, this is such a wondrous sight! Although only a few shields and spears remain, I'm sure the grand scenes of the past are already flashing before your eyes!
